a.lede: Nvidia’s new Open Agent Safety Platform combines OpenShell sandboxing with BlueField-powered Sentry hardware to monitor and rapidly quarantine rogue AI agents
a.title: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform to physically restrain rogue AI agents

b.lede: Chipmaker says new system was designed to prevent AI agents from going rogue amid incidents at top companies Nvidia on Monday unveiled a new security platform that the chipmaker said can stop artificial intelligence agents from going rogue. The company announced a $150bn stock buyback the same day. Continue reading...
b.title: Nvidia unveils security platform to rein in AI agents and $150bn stock buyback
